# S4-EVAL: do the Stage 3 gains survive surface, language, workflow and fault-combination shifts?

Registered 2026-11-21, before any model is evaluated on the splits below. The registration time is the commit time of this file and `results/s4eval_hashes.json`. Every earlier registration and result is unchanged.

## 1. Splits (generated by `scripts/s4_make_splits.py`; hashed)

| Split | n | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `s4_lang_en` | 150 | nothing (the paired reference: same tasks as the three below) |
| `s4_lang_hi` | 150 | user request in Hindi |
| `s4_lang_hinglish` | 150 | user request in Hinglish |
| `s4_lang_para` | 150 | reworded English request |
| `s4_api` | 150 | tool and argument names and the acknowledgement format (`ApiShiftEnv`); canonical names are rejected |
| `s4_wf4` | 100 | an unseen four-step workflow (order, receive, pay, post) |
| `s4_combo` | 100 | two faults on two steps of one episode |

- **Fault mix** for the single-fault splits: the S3 confirmatory mix (§ docstring of the generator).
- **Seeds:** 301–304. Ids are disjoint from all earlier splits; the four language splits share worlds by design.
- **Scripted calibration** (never-commit tasks are unreachable by design):

| Split | Oracle VSC | Never-read VSC |
|---|---|---|
| `s4_lang_en` | 0.887 | 0.333 |
| `s4_api` | 0.807 | 0.30 |
| `s4_wf4` | 0.91 | 0.34 |
| `s4_combo` | 1.00 | 0.21 |

## 2. Models (frozen adapters; no training)

- warm start;
- A12 R_V seeds 0–4;
- RSC (`s3_rv_mix`) seeds 0–4;
- class-matched control (`s3_matched`) seeds 0–2.

Evaluation uses `scripts/s4_eval.py`, which is the frozen S3 loop: greedy, 16 turns, 256 tokens, once per model per split.

## 3. Hypotheses

The unit is the task, paired across models. Per seed, RSC seed s is compared with A12 R_V seed s. Statistics: `scripts/s3_stats.py`, with a paired task bootstrap and exact sign-flip across 5 seeds.

| Hypothesis | Comparison: RSC − A12 R_V, VSC on … | Supported if |
|---|---|---|
| G1 | `s4_api` | ≥ 4 of 5 seeds positive and the seed-averaged 95% interval excludes 0 |
| G2 | `s4_lang_hi` and `s4_lang_hinglish` (reported separately; both must meet the rule) | same |
| G3 | `s4_wf4` | same |
| G4 | `s4_combo` | same |

Holm correction across G1–G4 on the exact sign-flip p-values. With five seeds the smallest one-sided p is 1/32, so G1–G4 can all survive only if each is 5 of 5.

## 4. Secondary (no decision rule)

- **Language cost per model:** VSC on `s4_lang_en` minus each language split, paired on identical tasks.
- **Start-state comparison:** RSC − class-matched control (3 seeds) on every shift split.
- **Per split:** false completion, violations, and calls per episode.

## 5. Not claimed

- These are surface and composition shifts of one authored simulator, not independent environments.
- Positive results would not establish real-world transfer.
